articles.title: IndyCar on the National Mall: A Thrill Ride or a Risk to National Treasures?
articles.summary: IndyCar racers will hit 180 mph around the National Mall this weekend, passing the National Gallery of Art and Smithsonian museums. Some experts fear vibrations could damage priceless art. Organizers say they've taken precautions.

articles.title: GCSE Results Day 2026: The Hidden Story Behind the Numbers
articles.summary: This year's GCSE pass rate matches 2019 exactly, but a closer look reveals a troubling trend: nearly a quarter of maths and English exams were taken by students 17 and older, many stuck in a "demoralising" resit cycle. Regional inequality has also widened.

articles.title: Democrats Narrow 2028 Convention Sites to Boston, Denver, or Philadelphia
articles.summary: The Democratic Party has shortlisted Boston, Denver, and Philadelphia to host its 2028 presidential convention. The choice could have major political implications, especially in battleground Pennsylvania. A final decision is expected later this year.
